title: Flux 2 Klein 4B image edit
description: Local single-image edit with the installed Flux 2 Klein 4B FP8 model. The source image is scaled to roughly one megapixel and used as a reference latent while the prompt describes the change. The exact graph has produced a verified 1024x1024 PNG on the qualified local ComfyUI 0.37.0 worker.

controls.label: Edit prompt
controls.default: Change the background to a snowy mountain at dusk, keep the foreground unchanged

GPU-qualified 2026-10-19 on ComfyUI 0.37.0 / RTX 4090 with the exact packaged graph: a 1024x1024 testsrc2 source (SHA-256 ef819bfb8fc9e97bd21bc39731bb117fb11b68da7c5cc0b0f48ed95fe4ff06) edited with the prompt 'Change the background to a snowy mountain at dusk, keep the foreground unchanged' produced a 1024x1024 PNG (1,425,159 bytes; SHA-256 0d751b60c1f907429745d730936d34ef6334d807c661ebe589f42b2b4d88a745) in 2.1 s on a warm worker (prompt 6e57dadf-c129-4ddf-95af-2f2d28d70afb). This proves graph execution and output structure. Edit fidelity, identity preservation, perceptual quality and arbitrary-aspect behavior are not proven.

Full ComfyField E2E on 2026-10-19: run d70f6035-b72b-4a6e-a5fc-25f549406bc9 succeeded with workflow hash e3a21cc496e6b9985defc6c0b4ac298a6c4462b11446f3a1a839a8d05252bdb6, imported asset Flux2-Klein_00001_.png at 1024x1024 in 6.1 s through the authenticated API and local ComfyUI worker.
